# YEPPDash

> Web dashboard for [YEPPBot](https://github.com/MCmoderSD/YEPPBot), a Twitch chatbot. Broadcasters sign in with Twitch and run the bot from a browser instead of only through chat commands: adding the bot to their channel, managing moderators and VIPs, timeouts and bans, custom commands, quotes, follower birthdays, raids, a viewer queue, two OBS overlays, and a channel point reward that buys a timeout.

YEPPDash is a free, open-source, solo-developed hobby project, not a commercial service. The dashboard lives at https://dash.yeppbot.com and the public site at https://www.yeppbot.com. Everything behind the dashboard requires a Twitch login and only ever acts on the signed-in user's own channel.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.yeppbot.com/): What YEPPDash does and how to sign in with Twitch.
- [FAQ](https://www.yeppbot.com/faq): What YEPPBot is, which Twitch permissions the dashboard asks for and why, and how finished the project is.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.yeppbot.com/privacy): What data is processed, how Twitch tokens are stored encrypted, and the GDPR rights that apply.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.yeppbot.com/terms): The terms that apply when using the dashboard.
- [Imprint](https://www.yeppbot.com/imprint): Operator details and contact address, per § 5 TMG.

## Features

Every page below is behind a Twitch login and acts only on the signed-in broadcaster's own channel.

- [Bot management](https://dash.yeppbot.com/): Have YEPPBot join or leave a channel and see whether it is banned, blocked, or a moderator there.
- [Moderators](https://dash.yeppbot.com/role-management?mode=0): Grant and revoke moderator status.
- [VIPs](https://dash.yeppbot.com/role-management?mode=1): Hand out and take back VIP badges.
- [Timeouts and bans](https://dash.yeppbot.com/timeouts): Who is timed out or banned and until when, with the means to end either.
- [Quotes](https://dash.yeppbot.com/quotes): Add, edit, reorder and bulk import or export a channel's quotes.
- [Custom commands](https://dash.yeppbot.com/commands): Write chat commands and their replies, with a live reload of the running bot.
- [Follower](https://dash.yeppbot.com/community): Who is around the channel and which roles they hold.
- [Birthdays](https://dash.yeppbot.com/birthdays): Track the birthdays of followers who set one.
- [Raids](https://dash.yeppbot.com/raids): Who raided the channel, with how many viewers, and when. Raiders are shouted out automatically.
- [Queue](https://dash.yeppbot.com/queue): A waiting list worked through in order, for anything where viewers take turns.
- [Lucky Wheel](https://dash.yeppbot.com/wheel): Spin a wheel of entries, live on an OBS browser source.
- [Subathon Timer](https://dash.yeppbot.com/timer): Count down live on an OBS browser source, driven from chat or the dashboard.
- [BDSM Test](https://dash.yeppbot.com/bdsm): Test results viewers have shared with the channel.
- [Timeout Reward](https://dash.yeppbot.com/timeout-reward): A channel point reward viewers redeem by typing a name, which times that viewer out for as long as the broadcaster set. Protected roles and unknown names are refunded automatically.

## Source

- [YEPPDash on GitHub](https://github.com/MCmoderSD/YEPPDash): The dashboard, ASP.NET Core backend and Angular frontend, BSD 3-Clause.
- [YEPPBot on GitHub](https://github.com/MCmoderSD/YEPPBot): The Twitch chatbot itself, BSD 3-Clause.
